name: manual_a67d0a
claim: Before restoring old credential env files, test each key by HTTP status and compare by length and hash only; a stale key sourced after the working one silently shadows it, so strip dead lines, keep the originals, and never print values.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-26: the old W&B, OpenRouter and Firecrawl keys returned 401 while the keys in the main env file returned 200; a masked diff script compares files without exposing values.
